title.narrative: Bridging the Gap of access to quality nutrition and healthcare services for women, girls, persons with disabilities in Hong Mubi North LGAs in Adamawa State.

description.narrative: ltpgtltbrgtThis project is for envelope 2 (National Women-led organizations leading women-led innovative solutions). The project will adopt a multi-sectoral approach, centered in the deeply affected area by the protracted crisis as well as flooding coupled with the nutrition needs of women, under 5 years and persons with disabilities. According to HNO, the project addresses health and nutrition concerns by deploying a community-centric strategy, leveraging innovative solutions, and tapping into existing local structures.ltbrgtIt will offer comprehensive activities tailored to meet the diverse needs of 57,000 (19,950 women, 22.800 girls, 5700 men and 8,550 boys) ltspangtbeneficiaries. A sum of 20,000 (4000 women, 8000 boys and 8000 girls)persons, including Persons with Disabilities, will benefit from specialized nutritional support, fortified food supplements, and educational programs to address malnutrition. This will include persons with disabilities, along with individuals requiring specific dietary and medical attention due to health vulnerabilities. Resources will be allocated to cater to 50,000 (15,000 boys and 35,000 girls) children under the age of five, focusing on essential healthcare services, immunizations and growth monitoring.lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtA critical aspect of the project involves empowering and engaging 30,000 women of reproductive age through access to comprehensive maternal healthcare services. This includes antenatal and postnatal care, skilled birth attendance, and family planning education to improve maternal and child health outcomes, reducing maternal mortality rates and promoting family well-being.ltbrgtMoreover, the intervention emphasizes community-based approaches, harnessing local structures and networks for effective implementation. It integrates innovation by utilizing mobile health clinics to reach remote areas, facilitating telemedicine for consultations, and employing local health workers and volunteers to disseminate health information and conduct door-to-door health education campaigns. By adopting a multi-sectoral, community-driven, and innovative approach, this intervention aims to address the pressing health and nutrition needs and overall community well-being, resilience, and sustainable development.ltbrgtIn alignment with envelope 2, FSACI will be partnering with Valfasam Care Initiative (VCI) for capacity building (Project management, ltbrgtFinancial Management, Systems, ltbrgtComplying with CSO Regulatory and Legal Frameworks, etc) and learning on the implementation to improve and strengthen the up-and-coming WLO for future implementation as well as localization.ltbrgtThe organization will ensure messages are passed through community structures like the religious, youth, traditional etc. This is to steer them to act and reduce water, health-related diseases ect that will lead to improving the well-being of women and girls.ltbrgtlt/pgt
